blocks.text: Kingdom Animalia ko bare paimane par phyla mein baanta jata hai. Is topic mein nau phyla bayan hain. Har phylum ke liye ek hi tarah ki baaton par dhyan dein: symmetry (jism ka tawazun), embryo ki tissue layers ki tadaad, body cavity (jism ki khokhli jagah), digestive (hazme ka), circulatory (khoon ki gardish ka), excretory (fuzla nikalne ka) aur nervous system, aur reproduction. Examiner inhi baaton ka muqabla poochhte hain.

blocks.title: Woh alfaaz jo har phylum mein aate hain
blocks.text: Diploblastic: jism embryo ki do layers, ectoderm aur endoderm, se banta hai. Triploblastic: teen layers, jin ke darmiyan mesoderm hota hai. Acoelomate: body cavity nahi hoti. Pseudocoelomate: ek jhooti (false) cavity, jis ke ird gird poori tarah mesoderm nahi hota. Coelomate: asal coelom, jo chaaron taraf se mesoderm se ghira hota hai. Protostome aur deuterostome coelomates ke do groups hain; naam is baat par hai ke embryo mein mouth kaise banta hai.

blocks.alt: Keere jaise jism ke teen cross-sections. Acoelomate: gut aur body wall ke darmiyan ki jagah tissue se bhari hai. Pseudocoelomate: gut aur body wall ke darmiyan fluid se bhari cavity hai, jis par mesoderm sirf bahar ki taraf hai. Coelomate: cavity dono taraf se mesoderm se ghiri hai aur gut us mein latka hua hai.
blocks.caption: Acoelomate, pseudocoelomate aur coelomate body plans (asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Har section mein bahar wala halqa body wall hai aur andar wala halqa gut. Flatworms acoelomate hain: parenchyma jagah bharta hai. Roundworms pseudocoelomate hain: cavity fluid se bhari hai lekin gut ko seedha chhooti hai. Molluscs, annelids, arthropods, echinoderms aur chordates coelomate hain: mesoderm body wall aur gut dono par hota hai.

blocks.text: 1. Phylum Porifera

Is phylum mein sponges aate hain. Zyada tar samandari (marine) hain, kuch meethe paani mein rehte hain. Leucosolenia aur Euplectella (Venus' flower basket) samandari sponges hain; Spongilla meethe paani ka aam sponge hai.

Sponges mein tissue level ki organisation nahi hoti. Zyada tar asymmetrical hain, kuch mein radial symmetry hoti hai, aur in mein nervous system nahi hota. Body wall mein bohat se soorakh hote hain jinhein ostia kehte hain; in se paani jism mein daakhil hota hai. Bara soorakh jis se paani bahar nikalta hai osculum kehlata hai. Jism ki bahar wali layer patle, chapte cells ki hoti hai jinhein pinacocytes kehte hain. Doosri layer jelly jaisi hoti hai aur mesohyl kehlati hai; is mein amoeboid cells hote hain. Teesri layer, jo darmiyani khokhli jagah (spongocoel) ko andar se dhaanpti hai, choanocytes ya collar cells ki hoti hai. Skeleton calcium carbonate ya silica ki bareek sooiyon (spicules) ki shakal mein hota hai.

Zyada tar sponges budding ya regeneration se asexual reproduction karte hain. Kuch sponges sakht capsules banate hain jinhein gemmules kehte hain. Jab parent sponge mar jata hai to woh apne gemmules chhor deta hai; munasib mahol mein gemmule se amoeboid cells bahar aa kar naya sponge bana lete hain.

blocks.alt: Guldaan (vase) jaisa sponge, kaat kar dikhaya gaya take us ki deewar aur darmiyani cavity nazar aaye. Bahar ki satah par bohat se chhote soorakh (ostia); upar ka bara soorakh osculum; andar ki layer collar cells (choanocytes) ki hai jin par flagella hain; layers ke darmiyan jelly jaisa mesohyl hai jis mein amoeboid cells aur sooi jaise spicules hain. Teer dikhate hain ke paani ostia se andar aa kar osculum se bahar jata hai.
blocks.caption: Sponge ki aam banawat (Figure 1.9 ke mutabiq asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Paani body wall ke ostia se andar khincha jata hai, spongocoel ko dhaanpne wale choanocytes ke paas se guzarta hai, aur upar ke ek bare osculum se bahar nikalta hai. Bahar wali layer pinacocytes, darmiyan mein mesohyl (amoeboid cells aur spicules ke saath), aur andar wali layer choanocytes.

fallback.text: Sponge ka body plan: paani ostia se andar, choanocytes ke paas se, aur osculum se bahar.
fallback.alt: Kate hue sponge body plan ki rendered tasveer.

blocks.title: Bazaar mein milne wale sponges
blocks.text: Commercial sponge is tarah banaya jata hai ke sponge ko sukha kar, peet kar aur dho kar us ke tamam cells nikal diye jate hain; sirf skeleton reh jata hai.
2. Phylum Cnidaria

Taqreeban tamam cnidarians samandari hain, agarche kuch, jaise Hydra aur kuch jellyfish, meethe paani mein milte hain. Zyada tar colonial hain, jaise Obelia, corals aur sea fans. Zyada tar sessile hain, yani ek jagah jure rehte hain, jaise Hydra, corals aur Obelia; kuch, jaise jellyfish, motile hain, yani harkat karte hain.

Cnidarians radially symmetrical aur diploblastic hain: baalig jism mein do tissue layers hoti hain, epidermis aur gastrodermis, jo ectoderm aur endoderm se banti hain. In ke darmiyan jelly jaisa mesoglea hota hai jis mein amoeboid cells hote hain jo kisi bhi layer se aaye ho sakte hain. Cnidarians mein khaas cells hote hain jinhein cnidocytes kehte hain. Har cnidocyte mein ek khaas organelle, nematocyst, hota hai, jo jism ki hifazat karta hai aur shikaar pakarta hai.

In mein ek band-sira (blind-ending) cavity hoti hai jise gastrovascular cavity ya enteron kehte hain. Yeh ek hi soorakh, mouth, se bahar khulti hai. Mouth hi anus ka kaam bhi karta hai, yani bina hazam hua maadda isi se bahar nikalta hai. Mouth ke gird projections ki ek qataar hoti hai jinhein tentacles kehte hain. Aisa digestive system jis mein ghiza daakhil hone aur fuzla nikalne ka ek hi rasta ho, sac-like (thaili jaisa) digestive system kehlata hai.

Nervous system body wall mein neurons ka ek jaal hota hai; central nervous system (dimagh aur spinal cord) nahi hota. Cnidarians mein respiratory, excretory aur transport systems nahi hote. Do body forms hoti hain: polyps belan (cylinder) jaise hote hain, apne aboral sire se kisi satah ke saath jure rehte hain, aur asexual reproduction karte hain; medusae chhatri jaise hote hain, azadana tairte hain, aur sexual reproduction karte hain.

blocks.alt: Cnidarians ki do body forms saath saath 3D model mein. Baayein polyp: ek seedha belan jo neeche se jura hai, aur upar mouth ke gird tentacles ka halqa. Daayein medusa: chhatri jaisi ghanti jis ka mouh neeche ki taraf hai, aur kinaron se tentacles latak rahe hain. Dono ko kaat kar do body layers aur darmiyani gastrovascular cavity dikhai gayi hai.
blocks.caption: Polyp aur medusa, cnidarians ki do body forms (asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Polyp ek sessile belan hai jis ka mouth aur tentacles upar ki taraf hote hain. Medusa wahi body plan ulta aur chapta kar ke azad tairne wali ghanti ban jata hai, jis ka mouth neeche ki taraf hota hai. Dono mein bahar epidermis, andar gastrodermis, darmiyan mein mesoglea aur ek gastrovascular cavity hoti hai.

fallback.text: Polyp: belan jaisa, jura hua, asexual. Medusa: chhatri jaisa, azad tairta, sexual.
fallback.alt: Polyp aur medusa ki rendered tasveer.

blocks.title: Corals
blocks.text: Corals colonial cnidarians hain. Yeh calcium carbonate ka sakht exoskeleton banate hain. Yahi skeleton coral islands aur coral reefs banata hai.
3. Phylum Platyhelminthes

Yeh flatworms (chapte keere) hain. Jism unsegmented, naram aur dorsoventrally compressed hota hai, yani upar se neeche chapta. Zyada tar azad rehte hain, jaise Planaria. Kuch insaanon aur doosre janwaron ke andar parasites hain, jaise liver fluke, tapeworm aur blood fluke.

Flatworms triploblastic hain: jism ke tissues embryo ki teen layers, ectoderm, mesoderm aur endoderm, se bante hain. Yeh acoelomates hain; body wall aur organs ke darmiyan ki jagah ek dheela connective tissue, parenchyma, bharta hai. In mein bilateral symmetry hoti hai, yani baayein aur daayein, aur dorsal (peeth) aur ventral (pait) ki waazeh simtein. In mein respiratory aur circulatory (transport) systems nahi hote.

Fuzla nikalne ke liye nali-numa protonephridia ka jaal hota hai jis ki bohat si shaakhein hoti hain. Har shaakh ke sire par ek bulb jaisa cell hota hai jise flame cell kehte hain. Flame cells ke cilia harkat kar ke aas paas ka fluid naliyon mein kheenchte hain; naliyan fluid se fuzla chhaan kar body wall ke ek chhote soorakh, nephridiopore, se bahar nikal deti hain. Nervous system neurons ka jaal hai jis mein aage ke sire (sar) mein cerebral ganglia hote hain. Yeh ganglia lambai mein jaane wali nerve cords se jure hote hain, jo jism mein aar paar shaakhon se aapas mein mili hoti hain. Zyada tar azad flatworms ke aage ke sire par do saada eyespots hote hain.

Flatworms fission se asexual reproduction karte hain: janwar darmiyan se sikur kar do tukron mein bat jata hai, aur har tukra ghaaib hissa dobara bana leta hai. Sexual reproduction karne wale flatworms hermaphrodites (bisexual) hain: ek hi fard mein nar aur maada dono organs hote hain.
4. Phylum Nematoda

Yeh roundworms (gol keere) hain, jin ka jism lamba, keere jaisa, gol aur dono siron par nokeela hota hai. Kuch paani aur mitti mein azad rehte hain, jaise Caenorhabditis elegans. Bohat se parasites hain, jaise Ascaris, hookworm, pinworm aur whipworm.

Roundworms triploblastic, bilaterally symmetrical aur unsegmented hain. Yeh pseudocoelomates hain: in mein ek jhooti body cavity, pseudocoelom, hoti hai jo fluid se bhari hoti hai. In ka digestive system nali jaisa (tube-like) hai: ek alimentary canal jis ke do soorakh hain, aage mouth aur peeche anus. Parasitic roundworms ka digestive system saada hota hai.

Excretory system protonephridia aur do excretory canals par mushtamil hai jo aage ke sire par mil kar ek canal banati hain; yeh canal pait ki satah (ventral surface) par ek nephridiopore se bahar khulti hai. Nervous system neurons ka jaal hai; pharynx ke gird ek nerve ring hoti hai jo chaar lambi nerve cords se juri hoti hai. Honton par baal jaise ubhre hue sense organs, sensory papillae, hote hain. Roundworms mein waazeh respiratory ya circulatory systems nahi hote. Yeh unisexual hain: nar nematodes mein testes aur maada mein ovaries hote hain.

blocks.title: Aschelminths
blocks.text: Pseudocoelomates ko saat phyla mein baanta jata hai, jinhein mila kar ek unit Aschelminths kehte hain. Phylum Nematoda is group ka numainda (representative) phylum hai.
5. Phylum Mollusca

Molluscs ka jism naram aur unsegmented hota hai, aur yeh qudrati maskanon mein door door tak paye jate hain. Kuch sirf paani mein rehte hain, jaise mussels, octopus aur oyster; doosre nam jagahon par, jaise zameen ka ghonga (land snail). Molluscs triploblastic aur bilaterally symmetrical hain, aur in mein asal coelom hota hai. Coelomates mein yeh protostomes ke group mein aate hain.

Jism ke teen hisse hote hain: head (sar), visceral mass (jis mein hazme, fuzla nikalne aur reproduction ke organs hote hain) aur foot (paon), jo visceral mass se jura hota hai. Visceral mass ke gird ek epithelial ghilaaf hota hai jise mantle kehte hain, aur mantle aur visceral mass ke darmiyan ki jagah mantle cavity kehlati hai. Zyada tar molluscs mein mantle ki bahar wali satah calcium ka khol (calcareous shell) banati hai. Bivalves ke siwa tamam molluscs mein ek raghadne wala, zubaan jaisa organ hota hai jise radula kehte hain.

Cephalopods ke siwa tamam molluscs mein open circulatory system hota hai. Dil mein ek ventricle aur do auricles hote hain. Digestive system nali jaisa hai, mouth aur anus ke saath. Fuzla nikalne ke liye nephridia naam ki nali-numa banawatein joron mein hoti hain: fuzla sinuses se jama ho kar dil ke gird coelom mein jata hai; nephridia isi coelom mein khulte hain, aur un ke soorakhon ke gird bareek cilia fluid ko coelom se nephridia mein le jate hain; phir nephridia fuzla mantle cavity mein chhorte hain jahan se woh bahar nikal jata hai. Gills gason ka tabadla karte hain. Teen jore ganglia hote hain, head, visceral mass aur foot mein, jo nerve cords se jure hote hain. Molluscs muscular foot se chalte hain; kuch sessile hain. Zyada tar unisexual hain.

blocks.title: Open circulatory system
blocks.text: Open system mein khoon naliyon (vessels) ke andar nahi rehta. Woh seedha tissue ki khaali jagahon, sinuses, mein cells ko nehlata hai.
6. Phylum Annelida

Annelids segmented worms (hisson mein bate keere) hain. Yeh samandar mein (jaise Nereis), meethe paani mein (jaise leech, yani jonk) aur nam mitti mein (jaise earthworm, yani kenchua) rehte hain. Kuch, jaise jonk, ectoparasites hain. Jism aar paar bohat se ek jaise hisson, segments, mein batta hai. Andar se segments ko cross walls, septa, alag karti hain, aur har segment mein apne circulatory, excretory aur neural hisse hote hain. Is qisam ki segmentation ko metameric segmentation kehte hain. Bahar se segments jism ki satah par chhote chhallon jaisi sikurnon se nazar aate hain; annelid ka matlab hi 'chhota chhalla' hai.

Annelids bilaterally symmetrical, triploblastic protostome coelomates hain. In mein setae hote hain: har segment ki ventral wall mein chitin ke bristles (sakht baal); jonk mein setae nahi hote. Body wall par epidermis ki banai hui nam, acellular cuticle hoti hai. Digestive system nali jaisa hai aur alag alag hisson mein batta hai jin ka apna apna kaam hai; parasitic annelids ka digestive system saada hota hai.

Fuzla nikalne ke liye cilia wale, qeef (funnel) jaise metanephridia hote hain, har segment mein ek jora. Circulatory system closed hai: khoon hamesha vessels ke andar behta hai, aur khaas dharakne wale vessels (pseudohearts) use dhakelte hain. Zyada tar annelids ke khoon mein respiratory pigment haemoglobin plasma mein ghula hota hai. Gason ka tabadla jild (skin) se hota hai. Aage ke segment mein cerebral ganglion ya dimagh hota hai, jis se ek dohri lambi ventral nerve cord nikalti hai jo har segment ko nerves deti hai; har segment mein ganglia bhi hote hain. Annelids mein tactile receptors, chemoreceptors, balance receptors aur photoreceptors hote hain, aur kuch mein lens wali achhi aankhein bhi. Zyada tar hermaphrodite hain (kenchua, jonk); kuch unisexual hain (Nereis).
7. Phylum Arthropoda

Arthropods mein keere (insects), crustaceans, makriyan (spiders), bichhoo (scorpions) aur centipedes shamil hain. Yeh har qisam ke maskan mein rehte hain, aur zameen par rehne wale bohat se ur bhi sakte hain. Yeh triploblastic, bilaterally symmetrical protostome coelomates hain, lekin coelom sikra hua hota hai aur sirf reproductive aur excretory systems ke gird hota hai.

Arthropods ke jointed appendages (joron wale aaza) hote hain jo khaas kaamon ke liye badle hue hote hain: daurna, rengna, tairna, shikaar pakarna, saans lena, reproduction wagaira. Mouth ke gird jointed appendages badal kar mouthparts banate hain. Jism segmented hai, aur kuch segments mil kar khaas hisse, tagmata, banate hain: head, thorax aur abdomen. Exoskeleton ya cuticle epidermis banati hai aur yeh zyada tar chitin ka hota hai. Chhote arthropods mein exoskeleton waqtan fawaqtan utarta hai; utarne ke baad janwar tezi se barhta hai aur phir naya exoskeleton banata hai. Is amal ko ecdysis ya moulting kehte hain.

Circulatory system open hai; zyada tar waqt khoon haemocoel mein behta hai, jo embryo ki ek cavity, blastocoel, se banta hai. Khoon berang hota hai kyunke is mein haemoglobin nahi hota, aur use haemolymph kehte hain. Zyada tar arthropods hawa ki naliyon, tracheae, se saans lete hain; in ki bari naliyan satah par spiracles naam ke soorakhon se khulti hain. Paani ke arthropods gills se saans lete hain. Digestive system nali jaisa hai, aur alimentary canal hisson mein bati hai. Fuzla nikalne ke liye Malpighian tubules hote hain: bareek naliyan jo alimentary canal se midgut aur hindgut ke jor par nikalti hain; nitrogen wala fuzla uric acid ke thos crystals ki shakal mein nikalta hai.

Central nervous system achhi tarah bana hota hai: sar mein cerebral ganglia ke teen jure hue jore dimagh banate hain, aur ek dohri ventral nerve cord har segment mein ganglia ka ek jora rakhti hai jin se chhoti nerves nikalti hain. Arthropods mein achhi tarah bani compound eyes aur antennae hote hain. Yeh apne maskan ke mutabiq tairte, rengte ya urte hain, aur unisexual hain. Aham arthropods: insects (machhar, titli, moth, bhir, beetles, tidda), kekre (crabs), lobsters, jheenga (prawns, shrimps), crayfish, makriyan, ticks, mites, bichhoo, centipedes aur millipedes.

blocks.title: Sab se kamyab invertebrates
blocks.text: Arthropods tamam invertebrates mein sab se kamyab hain. Taqreeban 900,000 species, yani zameen par naam di gayi tamam species ka do-tihai hissa, arthropods hain.
8. Phylum Echinodermata

Echinoderms sirf samandar mein rehte hain. Kuch biscuit jaise chapte hain (cake urchin), kuch chhoti bazuon wale sitara numa (sea star ya starfish), kuch gol (sea urchin), kuch lambi bazuon wale sitara numa (brittle star) aur kuch lambe (sea cucumber). Yeh triploblastic deuterostome coelomates hain. In ke larvae bilaterally symmetrical hote hain lekin baalig radial symmetry dikhate hain, jis mein jism ke hisse oral-aboral axis ke gird paanch ya paanch ke multiple mein tarteeb diye hote hain.

In mein calcium ki plates, ossicles, ka endoskeleton hota hai. Yeh plates mesoderm se banti hain lekin jild se bahar nikal kar kaante (spines) bhi banati hain. Echinoderms mein water-vascular system hota hai: coelom ke andar naliyon aur khaali jagahon ka nizam. Mouth ke gird ek ring canal hoti hai jo chhalni jaisi plate, madreporite, se bahar khulti hai. Ring canal se paanch (ya paanch ke multiple) radial canals nikalti hain; har radial canal se bohat si lateral canals nikalti hain, aur har lateral canal ek tube foot par khatam hoti hai. Tube feet water-vascular system ki extensions hain: yeh phail kar kisi satah se chipakte hain, aur jab chipke hue tube feet se paani wapas khincha jata hai to woh sikurte hain aur jism ko kheench lete hain.

blocks.alt: Upar se dekha gaya sea star jis mein water-vascular system banaya gaya hai: upar ki satah par chhalni jaisa madreporite ek chhoti canal se mouth ke gird ring canal se jura hai; ring canal se paanch radial canals bazuon mein jaati hain, har ek par chhoti lateral canals ki qataarein hain jo tube feet par khatam hoti hain.
blocks.caption: Sea star ka water-vascular system (Figure 1.16 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Paani madreporite se daakhil hota hai, ring canal ko bharta hai, paanch radial canals se lateral canals mein jata hai, aur tube feet par khatam hota hai. Feet phail kar pakarte hain; paani wapas khinchne se woh sikurte hain aur jism ko aage kheenchte hain.

blocks.text: Digestive system nali jaisa hai: mouth se oesophagus, stomach, intestine aur rectum tak, aur rectum anus se bahar khulta hai. Respiration aur excretion ke liye koi khaas organs nahi hote. Nervous system kamzor hai: ek nerve net, ek nerve ring aur paanch (ya paanch ke multiple) radial nerves. Zyada tar sensory receptors jism ki satah aur tube feet par phaile hote hain. Asexual reproduction mein jism do hisson mein batta hai aur har hissa regeneration se mukammal ho jata hai. Echinoderms unisexual hain.

blocks.title: Regeneration
blocks.text: Bohat se echinoderms khoye hue hisse dobara bana lete hain. Kuch, khaas kar sea stars aur brittle stars, hamla hone par jism ke hisse gira dete hain aur phir unhein dobara bana lete hain.
9. Phylum Chordata
Chordates bilaterally symmetrical, triploblastic deuterostome coelomates hain. Chaar khasoosiyat sirf chordates mein hoti hain aur development ke kisi na kisi marhale par maujood hoti hain.

items: Notochord: tamam chordates embryo ki zindagi mein notochord banate hain. Yeh vacuolated cells ka chhari jaisa, adh-sakht jism hai jo gut aur dorsal nerve cord ke darmiyan jism ki poori lambai mein hota hai. Neeche darje ke chordates isey poori zindagi rakhte hain; vertebrates mein development ke dauran yeh juzvi ya mukammal taur par vertebral column (reerh ki haddi) se badal jata hai.

Pharyngeal slits: pharynx ki side walls mein soorakhon ki ek qataar. Tamam chordates embryo mein jore-daar gill slits banate hain. Kuch mein (Amphioxus aur machhliyan) yeh gills ban jate hain; kuch mein (zyada tar amphibians) yeh zindagi ke kuch hisse mein kaam karte hain; baqi mein (reptiles, birds aur mammals) yeh doosre maqasid ke liye badal jate hain.
Tubular nerve cord: tamam chordates mein ek nali-numa nerve cord jism ki lambai mein, notochord ke bilkul dorsal (peeth ki taraf), chalti hai aur aage ki taraf phail kar dimagh banati hai.
Post-anal tail: tamam chordates ek dum (tail) banate hain jo anus se peeche tak jaati hai. Kuch isey poori zindagi rakhte hain; doosron mein yeh embryo ki zindagi mein hi khatam ho jaati hai.

blocks.alt: Ek aam chordate jism ka side view. Upar se neeche lambai mein: dorsal tubular nerve cord, us ke neeche notochord, aur us ke neeche gut. Aage ke sire par pharynx mein pharyngeal gill slits ki qataar hai; peeche jism anus se aage post-anal tail ki shakal mein jaari hai.
blocks.caption: Chordates ki chaar pehchaan wali khasoosiyat (Figure 1.17 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Tubular nerve cord notochord ke dorsal hoti hai, aur notochord nerve cord aur gut ke darmiyan. Pharyngeal slits pharynx ki side walls se khulte hain. Post-anal tail jism ka woh hissa hai jo anus ke peeche hai.

blocks.text: Phylum Chordata mein do bare groups hain: invertebrate chordates aur vertebrates. Subphylum Urochordata mein woh invertebrate chordates aate hain jin mein notochord aur nerve cord sirf azad tairne wale larva mein hote hain; sea squirts is ki misaal hain. Subphylum Cephalochordata mein woh invertebrate chordates aate hain jin mein notochord poori zindagi rehta hai; Amphioxus ek aam cephalochordate hai. Vertebrates mein vertebral column aur cranium (khopri) hota hai. Yeh saat classes mein batte hain jo do groups mein rakhi gayi hain; yeh agle topic ka mauzoo hai.

blocks.title: Textbook mein numbering
blocks.text: Textbook phyla ko 1 se 8 tak number deti hai aur phir Chordata ko 10; number 9 ka koi phylum nahi hai. Is lesson mein Chordata ko nauwan bayan hone wala phylum likha gaya hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasir khulasa

items: Porifera: tissues nahi, ostia aur osculum, pinacocytes, mesohyl, choanocytes, spicules, gemmules.
Cnidaria: radial, diploblastic, nematocysts wale cnidocytes, thaili jaisa gut, nerve net, polyp aur medusa.
Platyhelminthes: chapte, acoelomate, flame cells, cerebral ganglia, hermaphrodite.
Nematoda: gol, pseudocoelomate, nali jaisa gut, nerve ring, unisexual; Aschelminths.
Mollusca: head, visceral mass aur foot; mantle aur shell; radula; open circulation; nephridia.
Annelida: septa wale metameric segments; setae; metanephridia; haemoglobin ke saath closed circulation.
Arthropoda: jointed appendages, tagmata, chitin exoskeleton aur ecdysis, haemolymph, tracheae, Malpighian tubules, compound eyes.
Echinodermata: paanch ki buniyad par radial baalig, ossicles, madreporite aur tube feet wala water-vascular system, regeneration.
Chordata: notochord, pharyngeal slits, dorsal tubular nerve cord, post-anal tail; Urochordata, Cephalochordata aur vertebrates.

blocks.prompt: Har ishaare ka phylum batayein: (a) flame cells aur anus nahi; (b) radula aur mantle; (c) tube feet aur madreporite; (d) Malpighian tubules aur ecdysis.
